attributes.dataHandling: Text is sent to OpenRouter and served only by DeepInfra (US), with fallbacks off.
attributes.notes: OpenRouter publishes no weights revision; the revision is the date the space was fixed (pending confirmation). Calls pin the host: provider { only: ['deepinfra/us'], allow_fallbacks: false }. The standard text space (StandardTextVector) is this vectorizer at 1024 dimensions. OnTube's text vectors are its 256-dimension space, written 2026-11-03 with that pin (stored as int8, scale 1/127; no float originals kept). Until 2026-11-08 OnTube's queue that writes new talks' vectors allowed a Nebius fallback (cosine about 0.998 to DeepInfra), so a few recently added talks may hold Nebius-made vectors until they are vectorized again; every OnTube call is DeepInfra-only from then on. Chosen 2026-11-05 by a 150-query benchmark: nDCG@10 0.603 (Cohere Embed 5 Pro 0.640, Qwen3 0.6B 0.548, Titan V2 0.498).
